messages:
Sam PM: quick thread: three pilots asking for an accelerated onramp to 99.99% Dedicated SLA with burst guarantees. Want a safe, repeatable playbook we can use at GA.
Ivy Eng: we can do it if we control activation and have deterministic resource reservation. propose an "activation token" model: token only issued after gates pass.
Khalid SRE: ops gates I want: 72h soak, automated chaos run pass, golden metrics visible, and an emergency revoke path. activation token must be revocable.
June Sales: customers want automatic credits on breach but with an escrow cap. can we escrow credits and only release after burn-in completes? that reduces our risk.
Lena Docs: docs gaps: public explainer on tiered activation, internal playbook with owner matrix, and example credit calculation. I can draft both but need token semantics and escrow rules.
legal-bot: note: legal requires explicit measurement windows, carve-outs for maintenance/misuse, and a credit cap. will draft appendix if product defines escrow algorithm.
Sam PM: here's a sketch of the playbook steps:
1) Baseline test (perf harness) -> pass -> request activation token
2) Token issued (soft-active) -> 72h soak + chaos -> results uploaded
3) Token promotes -> 30d burn-in (metrics stable) -> token becomes full-active -> billing credits unlocked
4) Revoke token on sustained outages -> credits held until remediation
Ivy Eng: control-plane change: per-customer state machine with states: none -> token_held -> token_soft_active -> token_full_active -> token_revoked. expose an API to flip states with audit logs.
Khalid SRE: metrics to attach to token logs: p50/p95/p99, error_rate, slot_util, warm_hit_rate. alerts: sustained p99 > 250ms for 10m or error_rate > 0.5% -> auto-revoke token.
June Sales: escrow idea: when customer signs, we mark an escrow cap in contract (e.g., 3 months fees). credits are calculated but held in escrow until token_full_active; partial credits may be applied for Ramp stage.
legal-bot: suggested credit formula: credit = min( (out_of_slo_seconds / window_seconds) * monthly_fee, escrow_cap ). define window_seconds = 30*24*3600 and specify carve-outs.
Lena Docs: I'll write two artifacts: customer-facing "Activation Token" explainer + internal playbook mapping gates to owners and tickets. ETA 3 days.
Ivy Eng: engineering estimate: state machine + API + audit logs ~ 1 sprint; token enforcement in router + pre-reserved slots ~ 2 more sprints.
Khalid SRE: ops work: add token label to metrics, wire dashboards in Console to show token state per customer, and automate the chaos soak runs. ETA 10 days.
June Sales: I'll include the escrow language and staged credits in the commercial template and start pilot outreach.
Sam PM: GA rule proposal: we won't advertise 99.99% broadly at GA. we'll enable per-customer activation via tokens; require at least one pilot to reach full-active and for automation to be in place. otherwise capped public promise is 99.95 with token-based upgrade path.
legal-bot: I'll prepare SLA appendix and escrow clause draft; will post in 48h.
Lena Docs: will PR the playbook + explainer after legal lands.
Ivy Eng: starting the state machine PR today and will tag PROD ticket.
Khalid SRE: scheduling the first chaos soak for next Tue; will attach output.
Sam PM: thanks all. please update thread with PR/ticket links. check-in Friday. :thumbsup:
